title: 第11章 夏至
content_zh:
第11章 夏至
夏至雨点值千金。
朦朦胧胧的雨点打过田地，地里光秃秃的，散发着泥土味。南方麦早熟，新麦已经收割了，扎成一束一束，插在田野之上。
农户门在田埂上相互招呼着，油籽、蔓青与大芥也准备播种下去，待到秋末收成。
李通崖与李长湖几人盼星星盼月亮，扳着指头过日子，总算把夏至给盼来了。
天色方才灰灰暗，两人就端了案台，与李项平一同跪在案前。
法鉴由那螭龙纹镜架支着，案上摆着夏至收割的第一株新麦，几类瓜果，三杯夏雨泡成的清茶。
三人相视一眼，异口同声道：
“李家弟子李长湖/李通崖/李项平，恭请玄明妙法，司命安神，奉道修行。”
“当以时言功，不负效信，随箓焚化，身谢太阴。”
那鉴子上彩华流转，白光连连闪烁，镜面中赫然越起三道白丸，朝三人飞去。
三人连忙盘膝坐下，按着《接引法》中的法门引导符种，承接法诀。
看着白丸落入三人泥丸宫，李尺泾将目光收回，盘膝而坐，沉气入定，望着气海穴中白盈盈一片月华，思忖道：
“全凭法鉴提炼，八十一缕月华业已炼成，夏至日天气告生，阳明消暗，正是突破的好时机！”
初出牛犊不怕虎，李尺泾心念一动，双手结印，气海穴中波涛汹涌，八十一缕月华灵气飞速聚集，在气海穴中你追我赶，衔尾而游。
“入顶泥丸宫合成一处，下重楼十二环……故有腾腾之状也，生气袅袅，上重楼十二环，自舌下之窍而升……”
李尺泾默念《太阴吐纳养轮经》中凝聚玄景轮的法门，月华跃过十二重楼，汇聚在泥丸宫中凝聚成液，再纷纷流淌而下，在气海穴中聚成一片清潭。
“起！”
他轻喝一声，一道亮银色的光弧宛若水中月般从清潭中浮现，这光弧晶莹剔透，仿若极细的月牙，漂亮极了。
“十二重楼贯气海，清潭浮现玄景轮。”

望着这般景色，李尺泾不禁赞叹道，旋即催动法诀凝实玄景轮，尽力约束住它的形态。
只是时间缓缓流淌，玄景轮却迟迟未能真正落定，这月牙晶莹透亮，在潭中轻轻飘动，波光粼粼，浮游不定，一副随时会消散的模样。
李尺泾此时已是精疲力竭，勉力维持着玄景轮的形态，大滴大滴的汗水从他俊俏的脸庞上滑落，沾湿了他淡青色的衣袍。
正处进退两难间，气海穴中清潭哗啦啦地退开，一道白色符丸骤然飞起。
那符丸圆坨坨光灼灼，往那玄景轮上一定，剔透的月牙儿顿时稳住了形态，清潭中的法力也渐渐稳定，李尺泾长出一口气，运气收功。
玄景功成，体内的月华灵气转化为月华法力，李尺泾已经成为一名胎息境的修仙者！
他缓缓睁眼，望向案上在月晕中若隐若现的法鉴，躬身而拜。
“赐下仙法，凝炼月华，玄景功成，李家不胜受恩感激，此后年年月月，香火连绵，祀不断绝。”
李尺泾还有些稚嫩的声音却异常庄严，这个始终在哥哥们羽翼庇佑下的男孩赫然已经成了少年。
“泾儿。”
李木田静静地站在月光下，温和地看着自己的幼子。
“父亲，我已凝聚玄景轮。”
李尺泾站起身微笑看着父亲，左手轻轻展开，一道乳白色的法力浮现在手中。
“修行第一步叫作胎息，胎息境须要凝聚六轮，分别唤作玄景、承明，周行，青元，玉京，灵初。这玄景轮，便是入道之门。”
“好，好。”李木田老怀大慰，连连道。
挥手散去法力，李尺泾重新盘膝而坐，巩固起修为来。
————
“好法诀！”
李项平最先睁开眼，笑着伸了个懒腰，起身拿起桌面上的茶壶狠狠灌了一口。
“我得了那《太阴吐纳养轮经》和一道法诀，唤作避水法。”

话音才落，李通崖便从入定中醒了过来，他眉毛一挑，满足地开口道：
“我得了法诀，唤作驱邪术。”
两人将聊了一阵，李长湖才睁开眼睛，瞧着眼巴巴地盯着自己的三个弟弟无奈道：
“法诀唤作净衣术。”
待到三个哥哥都醒了过来，忍耐许久的李尺泾这才兴奋地开口：
“我已经凝聚了玄景轮！”
“这么快？”
李项平惊叹一声，有些疑惑地偏过头。
“全凭了法鉴之力。”
李尺泾望了望案上的法鉴，由衷地说：
“这鉴子自会凝聚月华，用来淬炼月华之力真真是事半功倍。”
李通崖几人这才恍然，李长湖摸了摸李尺泾的脑袋，笑着说：
“听闻书中道人体有灵窍，法力贯体便知其所在，泾儿可替我们看看。”
李长湖却是觉得自己接引时吃力无比，不比两个弟弟自如，暗暗怀疑起自己的修仙禀赋起来。
目光扫过三个哥哥，李尺泾将左手搭在最近的李项平的肩膀上，闭目寻起灵窍来。
“其气升腾，呼吸不止，如鱼踊跃……”
李尺泾默念着吐纳法中的形容，法力在李项平经脉中盘旋了一圈。
大约一柱香的功夫，他震惊地睁眼，喃喃自语：
“没有…”
他愣了愣，赶忙将手放在两个哥哥肩膀上，将法力一探。

“没有，怎么会没有？！”
李尺泾面色有些苍白，原地盘膝而坐，闭目入定，法力贯通全身，果然没有所谓的灵窍。
“《太阴吐纳养轮经》分明写了，灵窍是大道之基，任凭何种仙诀妙法，无灵窍便无法可言……”
“这…这……”
李尺泾心境波动不止，连入定都维持不住，颤抖着双唇，看着拨弄着茶叶的李木田，轻声道：
“父亲！”
“您说的对，这法鉴亦是我家灭门之祸。”
“若是有真修得知此物，我等不但身死形灭，魂魄拘于他人之手，整个黎泾村乃至整个古黎道大大小小的村落都会灰飞烟灭。”
“我已炼成玄景轮，法力流通全身，除非我废掉修为，否则那些练气士也无法用法力探知我灵窍所在。”
李尺泾悚然立起，郑重地嘱咐道：
“至于我李家子弟，授了玄珠符种未成玄景万万不可招摇过市！”
“正是。”
李木田饮了口茶，神色凝重地望着几人。
“当初泾儿能修行，我只以为是尺泾天赋异禀，韩文许曾说过，身具灵窍者千里无一，或许泾儿就是那一。”
他自嘲地笑笑，继续道：
“如今看来，这法鉴真是了不得的仙物，能化腐朽为神奇，授了这符种，凡人也能一窥仙道。”
几人又是庆幸又是惊惧，默然着看着父亲。
“行了，你们修炼去吧，我去田上看一看。”李木田沉默了半晌，开口道。
“是。”
几人自然低头应是，各自回房修炼。

李木田则恭恭敬敬地请回了法鉴，收拾了案台，背着手到田上去了。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 11 Summer Solstice
Summer solstice raindrops are worth a thousand pieces of gold.
Hazy raindrops hit the fields, which were bare and smelled of earth. Wheat matures early in the south, and the new wheat has been harvested, tied into bunches, and planted in the fields.
Farmers greet each other on the field ridges, and oilseeds, vines and mustards are also being sown for harvest in late autumn.
Li Tongya and Li Changhu looked forward to the stars and the moon, living their lives on their fingers, and finally looked forward to the summer solstice.
As soon as the sky turned gray, the two men took up the table and knelt in front of the case together with Li Xiangping.
The legal book is supported by the chilong-patterned mirror frame. On the table are the first new wheat harvested in the summer solstice, several types of melons and fruits, and three cups of tea made from the summer rain.
The three of them looked at each other and said in unison:
"Disciples of the Li family, Li Changhu/Li Tongya/Li Xiangping, respectfully request Xuanming's wonderful method to calm the mind and practice Taoism."
"You should show your merits at the right time, and if you live up to your promise, you should be burned in a urn, and your body should be thanked by Taiyin."
The colorful flowers on the mirror were flowing, white light flashed continuously, and three white pills suddenly appeared in the mirror and flew towards the three of them.
The three people hurriedly sat down cross-legged and followed the method guidance talismans in the "Jie Yin Method" to receive the method.
Watching the white pill fall into the three-person Niwan Palace, Li Chijing withdrew his gaze, sat cross-legged, fell into deep concentration, looked at the white moonlight in the Qihai Cave, and thought:
"It's all refined based on the Dharma. Eighty-one rays of moonlight have been refined. On the summer solstice, the weather is about to start, and the sun is dimming. It's a good time to make a breakthrough!"
A calf is not afraid of tigers when it first emerges. With a thought in his mind, Li Chijing formed a seal with his hands. The waves surged in the Qihai Cave. Eighty-one wisps of moonlight spiritual energy gathered rapidly. They chased each other in the Qihai Cave and swam tail to tail.
"Enter the Niwan Palace on the top to form one place, and go down to the twelve rings of the Chonglou... Therefore, it has the shape of soaring, with vitality curling up. It goes up to the twelve rings of the Chonglou, rising from the orifice under the tongue..."
Li Chijing silently recited the method of condensing the Xuanjing Wheel in the "Taiyin Breathing and Breathing Wheel Sutra". The moonlight jumped over the twelve floors, gathered in the Niwan Palace, condensed into liquid, and then flowed down one after another, forming a clear pool in the Qihai Cave.
"Get up!"
He drank softly, and a bright silver arc of light emerged from the clear pool like the moon in the water. This arc of light was crystal clear, like an extremely thin crescent moon, and was extremely beautiful.
"The twelve-story tower penetrates the sea of ​​qi, and the Xuanjing Wheel emerges from the clear pool."
Looking at such a scene, Li Chijing couldn't help but admire, and immediately activated the magic formula to solidify the Xuanjing Wheel, trying his best to restrain its shape.
It's just that time is flowing slowly, but the Xuanjing Wheel has yet to truly settle. The crescent moon is crystal clear, floating gently in the pool, sparkling and floating, looking like it will dissipate at any time.
Li Chijing was exhausted at this time, struggling to maintain the shape of the Xuanjing Wheel. Big drops of sweat slipped from his handsome face, soaking his light blue robe.
When he was in a dilemma, the clear pool in the Qihai Cave receded with a splash, and a white talisman pill suddenly flew up.
The talisman pill was round and bright, and it was fixed on the Xuanjing Wheel. The clear crescent moon suddenly stabilized its shape, and the magic power in the clear pool gradually stabilized. Li Chijing let out a long breath, and his luck came to an end.
Xuanjing succeeded, the Yuehua spiritual energy in his body was transformed into Yuehua mana, and Li Chijing had become an immortal cultivator in the fetal breath realm!
He slowly opened his eyes, looked at the Dharma Book on the case that was looming in the halo of the moon, and bowed before him.
"Given the immortal method, condensing the moonlight, and completing the Xuanjing, the Li family is extremely grateful for the kindness. Year after year, the incense continues and the sacrifices continue."
Li Chijing's still somewhat immature voice was extremely solemn. This boy who had always been under the wings of his brothers had suddenly become a teenager.
"Jing'er."
Li Mutian stood quietly under the moonlight, looking at his youngest son gently.
"Father, I have condensed the Xuanjing Wheel."
Li Chijing stood up and looked at his father with a smile. He gently opened his left hand, and a milky white mana appeared in his hand.
"The first step of practice is called fetal breath. In the fetal breath state, six rounds need to be condensed, which are called Xuan.Jing, Chengming, Zhou Xing, Qingyuan, Yujing, Lingchu. This Xuanjing Wheel is the door to the Tao. "
"well. "Li Mutian was greatly relieved and kept saying.
Waving his hands to disperse the magic power, Li Chijing sat cross-legged again and consolidated his cultivation.
————
"Good technique! "
Li Xiangping opened his eyes first, smiled, stretched, stood up, picked up the teapot on the table and took a deep sip.
"I obtained the "Taiyin Breathing and Nourishing Wheel Sutra" and a method called water avoidance method. "
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Tongya woke up from his trance. He raised his eyebrows and said with satisfaction:
"I obtained a magic trick called exorcism. "
The two chatted for a while, and then Li Changhu opened his eyes, stared at his three younger brothers helplessly and said helplessly:
"The technique is called the Art of Purifying Clothes. "
After all three brothers woke up, Li Chijing, who had been patient for a long time, spoke excitedly:
"I have condensed the Xuanjing Wheel! "
"So fast? "
Li Xiangping exclaimed and tilted his head in confusion.
“It all depends on the power of law. "
Li Chijing looked at the law book on the case and said sincerely:
"This jianzi will naturally condense the moonlight, and it can be used to temper the power of the moonlight, which will really get twice the result with half the effort. "
Li Tongya and others suddenly realized. Li Changhu touched Li Chijing's head and said with a smile:
"I heard in the book that the human body has a spiritual orifice, and if the magic power penetrates the body, we will know where it is. Jing'er can take a look for us. "
However, Li Changhu felt that it was extremely difficult for him to receive the invitation, and he was not as comfortable as his two younger brothers. He secretly doubted his talent for cultivating immortals.
Looking at the three brothers, Li Chijing put his left hand on the nearest Li Xiangping's shoulder, closed his eyes and searched for the spiritual orifice.
"The energy is rising, the breath is not stopping, and it is like a fish jumping..."
Li Chijing silently recited the descriptions in the Tuna method, and the magic power circled in Li Xiangping's meridians.
After about a stick of incense, he opened his eyes in shock and murmured to himself:
"No..."
He was stunned, then quickly put his hands on the shoulders of his two brothers and tested the magic power.
"No, how could it not be? ! "
Li Chijing's face was a little pale. He sat cross-legged on the spot, closed his eyes and meditated. His magic power penetrated his whole body. As expected, there was no so-called spiritual orifice.
"The "Taiyin Breathing and Nourishing Wheel Sutra" clearly states that the spiritual orifice is the foundation of the great road. No matter what kind of magic tricks are used, without the spiritual orifice, nothing can be said..."
"This...this..."
Li Chijing's mood kept fluctuating, and he couldn't even maintain his concentration. With trembling lips, he looked at Li Mutian who was playing with the tea leaves and said softly:
"Father! "
"You are right, this Dharma Book is also the cause of my family's destruction. "
"If any true cultivator learns of this thing, not only will our bodies and bodies be destroyed, but our souls will be trapped in the hands of others, the entire Lijing Village and even the entire villages of Guli Road will be wiped out. "
"I have refined the Xuanjing Wheel, and my magic power circulates throughout my body. Unless I abolish my cultivation, those Qi practitioners will not be able to use my magic power to detect the location of my spiritual orifice. "
Li Chijing stood up in horror and solemnly told:
"As for my descendants of the Li family, they must not show off to the public before they have achieved the Xuanjing after being given the Mysterious Bead Talisman Seed! "
"Exactly. "
Li Mutian took a sip of tea and looked at the few people solemnly.
"When Jing'er was able to practice, I just thought it was because Chi Jing was gifted. Han Wenxu once said that there is not one person in a thousand who has a spiritual orifice. Maybe Jing'er is that one. "
He smiled self-deprecatingly and continued:
"Now it seems that this Dharma Jian is really an incredible fairy. It can turn decay into magic. With this talisman, mortals can also have a glimpse of the immortal way. "
Several people were both happy and frightened, looking at their father in silence.
"Okay, you can go practice and I'll go take a look at the fields. "Li Mutian was silent for a while and then said.
"Yes. "
A few people naturally bowed their heads in agreement and went back to their rooms to practice.
Li Mutian respectfully asked for the Dharma Jian, cleared the desk, and went to the field with his hands behind his back.
(End of chapter)
